SELECT c.tid, c.column_name, c.column_comment, c.data_type, c.column_type, c.nullable, c.primary_key, c.is_unique, c.indexed, c.ordinal_position FROM db_table_column_t c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.table_id = #{tableId} AND c.is_del = 0 ORDER BY c.ordinal_position, c.column_name

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dq_quality_task_t q WHERE q.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND q.is_del=0) AS task_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dq_quality_task_t q WHERE q.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND q.is_del=0 AND q.status=1) AS task_enabled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dq_quality_run_t r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.is_del=0 AND r.created_time >= #{since}) AS run_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.violation_count),0) FROM dq_quality_run_t r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.is_del=0 AND r.created_time >= #{since}) AS violation_total, (SELECT AVG(r.quality_score) FROM dq_quality_run_t r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.is_del=0 AND r.created_time >= #{since} AND r.checked_count>0 AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED','COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES')) AS average_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dq_quality_run_t r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.is_del=0 AND r.status IN ('PENDING','INITIALIZING','RUNNING')) AS running_total

SELECT m.quality_dimension, COALESCE(SUM(m.checked_count),0) AS checked_count, COALESCE(SUM(m.violation_count),0) AS violation_count, AVG(CASE WHEN m.checked_count>0 THEN m.pass_rate ELSE NULL END) AS pass_rate FROM dq_quality_metric_t m JOIN dq_quality_run_t r ON r.tid=m.run_id AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.created_time >= #{since} WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} GROUP BY m.quality_dimension ORDER BY m.quality_dimension

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dq_quality_metric_t (tid,tenant_id,run_id,task_rule_id,rule_name,rule_type,quality_dimension,column_name,severity, weight_value,checked_count,violation_count,pass_rate,score,created_time,updated_time) VALUES (#{tid},#{tenantId},#{runId},#{ruleId},#{ruleName},#{ruleType},#{dimension},#{columnName}, #{severity},#{weight},#{checked},#{violations},#{passRate},#{score},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checked_count=checked_count+VALUES(checked_count), violation_count=violation_count+VALUES(violation_count), pass_rate=CASE WHEN checked_count=0 THEN 100 ELSE (checked_count-LEAST(checked_count,violation_count))*100/checked_count END, score=pass_rate,updated_time=VALUES(updated_time)

MERGE INTO dq_quality_metric_t target USING (SELECT #{tenantId} tenant_id,#{runId} run_id,#{ruleId} task_rule_id FROM dual) source ON (target.tenant_id=source.tenant_id AND target.run_id=source.run_id AND target.task_rule_id=source.task_rule_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.checked_count=target.checked_count+#{checked}, target.violation_count=target.violation_count+#{violations}, target.pass_rate=CASE WHEN target.checked_count+#{checked}=0 THEN 100 ELSE ((target.checked_count+#{checked})-LEAST(target.checked_count+#{checked},target.violation_count+#{violations}))*100/(target.checked_count+#{checked}) END, target.score=target.pass_rate,target.updated_time=#{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (tid,tenant_id,run_id,task_rule_id,rule_name,rule_type,quality_dimension,column_name,severity,weight_value, checked_count,violation_count,pass_rate,score,created_time,updated_time) VALUES (#{tid},#{tenantId},#{runId},#{ruleId},#{ruleName},#{ruleType},#{dimension},#{columnName},#{severity},#{weight}, #{checked},#{violations},#{passRate},#{score},#{now},#{now})

MERGE INTO dq_quality_metric_t target USING (SELECT #{tenantId} tenant_id,#{runId} run_id,#{ruleId} task_rule_id FROM dual) source ON (target.tenant_id=source.tenant_id AND target.run_id=source.run_id AND target.task_rule_id=source.task_rule_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.checked_count=target.checked_count+#{checked},target.violation_count=target.violation_count+#{violations},target.updated_time=#{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (tid,tenant_id,run_id,task_rule_id,rule_name,rule_type,quality_dimension,column_name,severity,weight_value,checked_count,violation_count,pass_rate,score,created_time,updated_time) VALUES (#{tid},#{tenantId},#{runId},#{ruleId},#{ruleName},#{ruleType},#{dimension},#{columnName},#{severity},#{weight},#{checked},#{violations},#{passRate},#{score},#{now},#{now})

INSERT INTO dq_quality_metric_t (tid,tenant_id,run_id,task_rule_id,rule_name,rule_type,quality_dimension,column_name,severity,weight_value,checked_count,violation_count,pass_rate,score,created_time,updated_time) VALUES (#{tid},#{tenantId},#{runId},#{ruleId},#{ruleName},#{ruleType},#{dimension},#{columnName},#{severity},#{weight},#{checked},#{violations},#{passRate},#{score},#{now},#{now}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,run_id,task_rule_id) DO UPDATE SET checked_count=dq_quality_metric_t.checked_count+EXCLUDED.checked_count,violation_count=dq_quality_metric_t.violation_count+EXCLUDED.violation_count,updated_time=EXCLUDED.updated_time

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(row_count),0) FROM dq_quality_run_shard_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId}) AS row_count, COALESCE(SUM(checked_count),0) AS checked_count, COALESCE(SUM(violation_count),0) AS violation_count, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN checked_count>0 THEN weight_value ELSE 0 END),0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN checked_count>0 THEN score*weight_value ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN checked_count>0 THEN weight_value ELSE 0 END) END AS quality_score FROM dq_quality_metric_t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId}
